title: handling of "No established PFCP Association"
body:
Hi,

We have this odd issue where upg-vpp upf suddenly losts UE context and seems like it removes association with SMF.
After this all PDUs are rejected until SMF is restarted and new association done with UPF.

UPF is answering with "Cause : No established PFCP Association" to Session Establishment Requests that the SMF sends.

Should SMF try to establish new association with the UPF in this case?
